result.notes:
Only infrastructure/work_source.py now writes into the artifact folder of a piece and builds or runs orch.py source command lines (knowledge/p11-refactor#fs). Test first: tests/test_boundaries.py got test_plan_artifacts_and_transitions_only_in_the_work_source_module. It is an AST rule over packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/** except work_source.py: no `/` path that names item.artifacts, artifacts, artifacts_dir or orch-artifacts; no literal ["source", <verb>, ...] command line; no call of _orch/run_orch. A companion test proves each form is seen. It was red on 7 places (loop.py:228, files.py:20, advice.py:63, checks_stage.py:94, finish.py:40 and :52, review.py:180). Moved into work_source.py: FALLBACK_ARTIFACTS (still re-exported by engine.py), open_artifacts (item.artifacts from the brief), write_artifact (stage-report.json, review-verdict.json, advice-N.json), evidence_dir (the evidence folder passed to the checks), register_args (the source register arguments) and closer_command (the command line of the model registrar, out of stages/close.py). All are bound on Conductor like the other layer functions. Behaviour unchanged: bash scripts/test.sh -p test_boundaries.py green; bash scripts/test.sh -p 'test_c[oh]*.py' (characterization, test_conductor*, test_contracts*, test_conformance: 545 tests) green. Repeat conformance on fake engines: orch.py conformance with a temporary HOME exited 0 (33 PASS, 10 DECLARED, 5 N/A, no FAIL; output in /tmp, not in the repo). CHANGELOG.md got a 'Changed' entry for P11.
Changed: CHANGELOG.md, packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/application/loop.py, packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/engine.py, packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/infrastructure/files.py, packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/infrastructure/work_source.py, packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/stages/advice.py, packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/stages/checks_stage.py, packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/stages/close.py, packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/stages/finish.py, packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/stages/review.py, packages/orch/tests/test_boundaries.py
